title: Handle requests from the server
excerpt: Handle requests from the server Declare what your client can do Declare each capability in the Client constructor's options — a server only sends your client a request it declared a capability for, and the SDK enforces that on both sides. Every result quoted on this page comes from this client connected over an in memory transport pair to a server whose tools elicit input and request sampling.
